name: Get Analysis Archive
description: Download the archive of a VMRay analysis (or one file of it) into the playbook run's storage — costs no quota.

analysis_id.description: VMRay analysis ID — e.g. the `analysis_id` of an analysis in Build Report's report, or of a screenshot of Get Sample Screenshots.
analysis_id.title: Analysis ID

archive_path.description: One file of the archive, such as 'logs/summary.json', instead of the whole ZIP. Leave empty for the whole archive. A path that is absolute or contains '..' is an error.
archive_path.title: Archive path

max_size_mb.description: The largest answer accepted, in megabytes; a bigger one fails the action instead of filling the playbook run's storage.
max_size_mb.title: Max size (MB)

files.description: The saved file as {"path": ...} in the playbook run's storage.
files.title: Files

size.description: Size of the file in bytes.
size.title: Size
